input: I think a fun project would be vr like workplace for working with agents. something to work on just for fun. based on progress and also to add tasks etc. also a browser etc ui for adding tasks. by voice or text. not very high priortiy
task: Owner request: a fun VR-like workplace for working with agents, showing progress, with a browser UI to add tasks by voice or text.

errors.what: First push: VENTURE.yaml evidence 'usage' is not an allowed kind, and the new page was a sibling-link orphan.

doc_friction.issue: Lists the count checks without paths; sync_readme_counts.py lives in gitops/ci/, not platform/ci/ like the other two, which cost one failed call.

deviations.why: No separate docs/posts write-up: this was a low-priority for-fun build, and the README plus llms.txt carry what a reader needs. Not a WebXR app either: a CSS 3D room runs on any phone with no dependencies, and the page says plainly that it is VR-style, not VR.

notes: New venture ventures/agent-workroom. node --test engine.test.mjs page.test.mjs: 25/25 pass. Headless Chromium (Playwright) at 1280x900 and 390x800: example board loads, W/arrow keys move the camera, typed command adds a task, a mocked GitHub response of three PRs (draft/open/merged) gives three tasks on Claude/Codex/Dependabot desks with the right statuses, state survives reload, no page errors, no horizontal scroll at 390px. Voice not tested end to end (no microphone headless). launched.mjs --write, regen.mjs, sync_tree_counts.py, publish_surface.py run; venture-preflight.mjs agent-workroom: 'preflight clean for agent-workroom', exit 0. Main was red on readme-live-links-ci after PR #9958 moved the Pages base to /oss-monorepo/ without touching READMEs; this PR carries the fix (pure URL swap in 2355 ventures/research READMEs, plus the two venture tests that pinned the old README URL: interview-content-studio 40/40, conformal-prediction-intervals 46/46). research_live_links.py and venture_live_links.py exit 0; their unittests and test_no_dead_pages_base pass. portfolio/router/validate.py and platform/pages/siblings.test.mjs pass after fixing two first-push CI findings (evidence kind; orphan page, now linked from agent-instructions-drift-check, whose tests pass 48/48).
